title: CrmSignRequestInput
description: Read from the merged `{ ...ctx.config, ...ctx.inputs }` bag (inputs win) — chain-authored config and DAG-forwarded inputs are both legal sources, so nothing is `required` here; the SURFACE refuses a missing key with a typed `validation_error` (a node failure, never success-with-empty).

signRequestId.description: Explicit `sign-request:`-prefixed id (ADR 0162). Omitted, the node derives `sign-request:${runId}:${nodeId}` — a PER-RUN dedupe key (a retried node converges), not a cross-run fork guard; the `side-effect` classification is the guard.

target.description: What is signed; content-hashed (SHA-256) at request time.
